messages:
Kelly: Heads-up — BrightBridge just escalated: users in their org lost access to the 'prod-gptx' model and console actions after last night's RBAC role pruning. Customer can still authenticate but gets 403 on model calls and billing page.
Tomas: Confirmed from customer side. Error when hitting /v1/models/prod-gptx/generate:
HTTP 403 {
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "details": "missing: models.generate"
}
Kelly: Assigning to security + infra to triage. @Raj can you pick this up? :raising_hand:
Raj: Looking. Initial guess: role attribute key renames in the roleset migrate may have dropped the models.generate grant for some tenant-scoped roles. Pinging audit logs.
SupportBot: Audit log query complete for org brightbridge: 2269992000-2269998700, see /audit/2269/brightbridge.csv
Mei: I pulled gateway logs. Traffic routed to region-us-west-2, policy evaluation shows DENY with policy_id=rbac-v2-tenant-default and condition 'has_model_binding == false'.
Raj: That condition shouldn't exist for users with role.project:engineer. Running local eval with policy simulator...
Raj: Repro: simulator returns deny when attribute org_member.role_key == 'proj_eng' (old) vs 'project:engineer' (new). Looks like attribute mapping table lost the legacy alias in the migration script.
Kelly: Oof. Any quick workaround we can apply for BrightBridge while we fix mapping?
Mei: We can add a temporary binding at tenant scope: grant resource 'models:prod-gptx' action 'generate' to role 'org_admin' or create a policy override. Will need manual approval from infra oncall.
Tomas: Customer asked for minimal blast radius — prefer to grant a model-specific binding rather than org_admin.
Raj: Created emergency policy patch: `PATCH /policies/overrides/brightbridge` payload: ```{ "bindings": [{ "role": "tenant:legacy-model-access", "resources": ["models:prod-gptx"], "actions": ["models.generate"] }], "ttl": "48h" }``` Applying now.
DeployBot: Deploy started for policy override brightbridge @ 2269998899 — rollout to policy engine in 3 nodes.
Mei: Applied on node-1 and node-2. Node-3 draining, should be up in ~30s.
Tomas: Customer reports model generate success now. They also validated console billing page loads for their org admin account.
Kelly: Great. Root cause: migration script removed legacy alias 'proj_eng' from attribute mapping, so existing role assignments evaluated to no-match. Raj, can you open a PR to reintroduce alias mapping and add a regression test for tenant-scoped role attributes?
Raj: Yep. PR #8592 created: fixes mapping, adds unit + integration test against policy simulator. Will add a migration backfill job to mark affected tenants and run in batches.
Raj: Backfill plan: 1) detect tenants with role attrs matching old aliases, 2) add alias mapping record, 3) emit audit event. We'll run in low-traffic window and monitor error rate. ETA for PR merge and canary: ~4h.
Kelly: Leave the emergency override in place until backfill complete. Set TTL to 48h so it auto-expires.
Mei: I'll add a Grafana alert for policy_deny_rate for tenant=brightbridge and for models.generate 5xx/403 spikes.
Tomas: Customer asked for a postmortem and timeline. I'll prepare a brief summary and ask for exact audit events to include.
SupportBot: Incident ticket created INC-2026-226999 with timeline skeleton.
Kelly: Thanks all. Tagging for follow-up: @Raj add remediation checklist in the PR, @Mei add monitoring dashboard link, @Tomas include customer confirmation in the ticket.
Raj: Noted. Will merge and schedule backfill tonight in maintenance window.
Tomas: Customer confirmed final access and is satisfied with the scoped override. Closing on customer side once backfill runs.
Kelly: Closing our internal thread once backfill completes + PR merged. :white_check_mark:
